job.job_description:
Job Title: AI Engineer Generative AI & Document Intelligence
Experience: 4 to 8 Years
Location: Kolkata (Hybird/Remote)
Employment Type: Full-Time



We are hiring for one of the top IT services companies.
SPADTEK Solutions is proud to collaborate with leading IT organizations to source exceptional talent for their full-time and Contract positions. Client/Implementation Partner is a globally recognized IT services and consulting company, trusted by Fortune 500 clients and enterprises worldwide. With a strong presence across cloud, data engineering, AI, and digital transformation and is known for delivering cutting-edge solutions that drive business growth and innovation. Working on enterprise-scale projects with global clients. Exposure to next-gen technologies across cloud, data, and digital platforms. A culture that values continuous learning, collaboration, and career growth. Being part of a company consistently ranked among the top IT employers. If you are an experienced professional seeking a long-term career opportunity with one of the industry s most respected names, this is your chance to join top IT services company through SPADTEK Solutions.

Job Summary
We are seeking a talented AI Engineer Generative AI & Document Intelligence with 3+ years of experience in designing and developing AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python, Generative AI, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Azure OpenAI/OpenAI APIs, Vector Databases, and document intelligence solutions. You will work on innovative AI initiatives for Defence and Shipbuilding domains, building intelligent document processing and semantic search solutions while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications using Generative AI technologies.
Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
Develop semantic search solutions using vector databases.
Integrate Azure OpenAI/OpenAI APIs into enterprise applications.
Implement OCR and intelligent document processing workflows.
Work with LangChain and/or LlamaIndex to orchestrate LLM-based applications.
Collaborate with solution architects, product teams, and stakeholders to understand business requirements.
Participate in customer discussions to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Develop AI solutions for Defence and Shipbuilding industry use cases.
Optimize AI models for performance, scalability, and accuracy.
Stay updated with the latest advancements in Generative AI, LLMs, and document intelligence technologies.
Required Skills
4 to 8 years of experience in AI/ML or Python development.
Strong programming skills in Python.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Experience with Azure OpenAI Service and/or OpenAI APIs.
Strong understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, ChromaDB, Milvus, or Weaviate.
Hands-on experience with LangChain and/or LlamaIndex.
Experience in OCR and document processing solutions.
Good understanding of prompt engineering and LLM optimization.
Familiarity with REST APIs, Git, and cloud-based application development.
Good to Have
Experience with Document Intelligence platforms (Azure Document Intelligence, Google Document AI, etc.).
Knowledge of Agentic AI frameworks and autonomous AI workflows.
Experience handling engineering, manufacturing, or technical documentation.
Exposure to Azure cloud services and AI ecosystem.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, or CI/CD pipelines.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.


Disclaimer : This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
